title: UW Calc Engine Result
description: Output of a single safe-expression evaluation by a Tier-3 Calc Host. Mirrors the CalcResult interface in @uwmd/core/protocol.ts. See UW_PROTOCOL_v1.md §VIII for the safe-expression language and the deterministic-evaluation contract.

ok.description: True if evaluation succeeded. False when `error` is set.

value.description: Result of the expression. Null when an input was null (per the null-propagation rule §VIII.2) or when ok=false.

unit.description: Unit string copied from the calc declaration (e.g. '%', '$', 'x', 'units'). Renderers use this to pick a number formatter.

display.description: Pre-formatted display string per DEFAULT_NUMBER_FORMAT (en-US in v1). Convenience for renderers that don't want to re-format.

error.description: Set when ok=false. Code MUST be one of CALC-PARSE-001, CALC-RESOLVE-001, CALC-TYPE-001, CALC-DIV-ZERO, CALC-IRR-DIVERGE, CALC-LIMIT-001, or a module-prefixed code.

error.message: Division by zero in expression 'a / b' (b = 0).
